messages.subject: log scale on y-axis
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if I can use ggplot2 to have the y-axis come out on log scale and have the annotation in levels. Here's an example with plot() :-

x <- 1:100
y <- 101:200

plot(x, y, log="y")

Here, the y axis scale comes out in log scale, but the annotation is done in the world coordinate system.

Thanks!

Regards,
Vimal

messages.author: a2635d832f33c5bb
messages.subject: Re: log scale on y-axis
parts:
I guess this does exactly the same as plot:
p <- qplot(x,y,log="y")
p + scale_y_continuous(formatter = "comma")

Hope this helps

-Ista
